name: Azel
message: 「Why do you come pick him up every day?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because my house is on the way from Yuugiri-an to the academy.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah! It's just on the way.」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't tell me. Does this man get lost if you don't guide him?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You thought of me like that?! Have a little more faith in me!」

name: Synn
message: 「My mom and dad asked Nanaka to look after me while they're away.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-Because we're childhood friends! Got a problem with that?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Why're you even asking about that anyway, Azel?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Why'd you suddenly start wondering about that?」

name: Synn
message: 「People aren't things you can divide neatly like that. Even I often wonder why I get hungry, you know?」

name: Eddie
message: 「Well, I'm gonna head over to Prier.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, Synn's side dish looks pretty fancy.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's just leftover tomato omelet from last night! It's easy, cheap, and delicious!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's 'cause it was packed with love~ Pro~bably~」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Azel eats instant ramen every single night.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn just can't leave something like that alone, can he?」

name: Ria
message: 「The demons have stopped showing up, haven't they?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm. Isn't it a bit too soon to assume that after only about a week?」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, really. I just hope things stay quiet like this.」

name: Ria
message: 「Are you going to pick up Azel-chan again today?」

name: Ria
message: 「Be careful, okay? As a boy, you have to be reliable.」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course! I'll make sure to walk her all the way home!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... I can handle it on my own, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, you be careful too, Nanaka-chan.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What a way to greet someone right off the bat.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Everyone, please keep quiet in the library.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Before you head home, why don't you calm down a bit?」
Three teacups filled with amber-colored black tea were placed in front of us.

name: Azel
message: 「...Why did the two of you come today?」

name: Synn
message: 「I told her I'd be fine on my own, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you talking about? If it were just you, Synn, it'd be too much for you to handle if you ran into any demons, wouldn't it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please don't mind me. I've already heard plenty from Azel.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, it's just... I didn't think you were the type to say stuff like that, Azel.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I don't know how strong our opponents might be, but thinking two people can ensure safety better than one is entirely rational.」

name: Azel
message: 「They won't attack. This guy alone is plenty to escort her.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, you can't say that for sure, can you?」

name: Synn
message: 「You say that like you have proof.」

name: Azel
message: 「They haven't been attacking lately, have they?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We don't know what'd happen if someone was walking alone, though!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd be glad if they stopped their attacks too, but as long as we don't know what they're thinking, we can't be certain.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In the first place, if they're definitely not going to attack, then Synn wouldn't even need to come here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whether the Demons are around or not, walking alone after it gets late is dangerous.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm a delicate maiden too, you know!」

name: Azel
message: 「If you're delicate, you'd just get in this guy's way--you wouldn't be any help in a fight.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Listen. You're the one who's actually being targeted, aren't you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see. So that's how it is.」

name: Melilot
message: 「For today, I think it would be best if the three of you went home together nicely.」

name: Azel
message: 「...There is no reason for us not to get along.」
Did I just hear a noise?
I jump out of bed. Something I can use as a weapon...
I could've sworn there was something nicely vicious-looking to hit someone with around here.
Thieves are scary, but if I don't do it, who will!
Even without a weapon, I still have my fists!

name: Synn
message: 「Is what I thought, turns out it was you, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「H-How rude! Someone as aligned with the divine will as I--」

name: Azel
message: 「Being around you only makes me more irrational.」

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, what were you doing?」

name: Synn
message: 「Going outside at this hour is dangerous. You just got back, didn't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「I see! The night breeze sure is nice.」

name: Azel
message: 「Indeed! The night breeze is quite nice.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I can't help worrying. Let me know when you leave the house.」

name: Synn
message: 「There's that too, yeah. Though if I had to say...」
I searched for the right words for a moment.

name: Synn
message: 「With you, Azel, I just can't leave you alone. So being a Demon or whatever doesn't really matter.」
Right after saying it, I felt kind of embarrassed.
I wasn't really sure why, though.

name: Azel
message: 「I... I see. So you cannot leave me alone.」

name: Synn
message: 「She knows this area pretty well, and she's reliable, so.」

name: Synn
message: 「Not that I'm saying you aren't reliable, Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right! Can I go on walks with you from now on?」

name: Azel
message: 「W-well, if it's only once in a while... fine...」
